What We Offer

Our Cleaning Services

Every clean is carried out by Rhianne personally — the same trusted face, every time. No agencies, no strangers.

Most Popular 🏠

Domestic Cleaning

Regular weekly or fortnightly cleans for your home. Consistent, reliable, and tailored to exactly how you like things done.

From £20/hr
🏖️

Holiday Let & Airbnb

Fast, thorough turnaround cleans between guests. Reliability is everything — a missed changeover is a lost review.

From £85/clean

End of Tenancy

Deep cleans that meet letting agent standards — top to bottom, so your deposit is protected and the property shines.

From £175/job

About Rhianne

20 Years of Gold-Standard Service

Before founding Evans Above Cleaning, Rhianne spent over 20 years as a Customer Service Specialist at SWALEC — one of Wales's major energy providers. Two decades of working to the highest professional standards in a regulated environment.

That experience — attention to detail, reliability under pressure, genuine care for people — is the foundation of everything Evans Above does. You don't just get a clean home. You get a cleaner you can trust.
